versions.subject: New rules
versions.detection:
selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
        # Add more if known
        - \WmiPrvSE.exe
        - \svchost.exe
        - \dllhost.exe
    Image|endswith: '\ImagingDevices.exe'
selection_child:

condition: 1 of selection_*
